moments.text: IR view looking down at a vessel on the sea, crosshair on it; green overlay lines and many black boxes mask parts of the image.
A small white dot rises from the left side to the green horizon line, left of the vessel, in under 0.5 s: use frame step.
White, black and noisy frames as the view switches: a wider view, the vessel again, then it slides off lower left at 12 s.
Darker view, pale ring upper left. From 0:19 a tiny white dot enters along the top edge, drifts left and down, then wanders faintly.
The image turns flat grey. From 0:49 a small white dot rises from lower left toward the crosshair, then roams left of it.
Zoom in: grainier picture, larger dot roaming the left half; low left near 1:28, near the top at 1:32 and 1:39, by the crosshair 1:42.
Second zoom: noisier image and a bigger white oval, wandering left of the crosshair between the upper left and the horizon line.
A black mask covers right of centre. A blue square frames the crosshair 2:09–2:11 as the oval climbs past it and out the top.
The view changes, flashes white, then shows a bright band across the top as the clip ends.
